Debrief DB-021
1) The actor created duplicate accounts under fabricated reviewer identities, leaving registered user profiles in the system while skipping the institutional verification step.
2) The actor fabricated positive review texts for targeted manuscripts, leaving stored review records in the database while skipping the plagiarism and similarity checks on the review content.
3) The actor submitted negative reviews against a competitor's submission, leaving timestamped rejection scores in the audit log while skipping the conflict-of-interest declaration requirement.
4) The actor concealed relationships with the authors of the promoted papers, leaving undisclosed affiliation metadata in the account history while skipping the mandatory ethics attestation.
5) The actor routed the fabricated reviews through separate sessions to mimic independent participation, leaving distinct IP addresses in the access logs while skipping the editorial policy review of reviewer independence.
